title: Formal models after a group-isomorphism monoid extension
statement:
Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a nonzero Noetherian local commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $R,Q$ fine saturated monoids [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], and $h:R\to Q$ a homomorphism inducing an isomorphism on group completions. Let $\alpha:R\to(A,\cdot)$ be a homomorphism, put $G=\alpha^{-1}(A^\times)$ and $S=R_G/G^{\rm gp}$, where $R_G=\{r-g:r\in R,g\in G\}\subset R^{\rm gp}$. Suppose a homomorphism $a:S\to(A,\cdot)$ and a character $\epsilon:R^{\rm gp}\to A^\times$ have been chosen such that $\alpha(r)=\epsilon(r)a(\bar r)$ for every $r\in R_G$, where $\bar r$ denotes its image in $S$ and $\alpha$ is extended to $R_G$ by inverting its units. Assume the maximal-ideal completion $\widehat A$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], compatibly with the monomials $a(u)$, has one of the following presentations for some finite $n\ge0$: (a) $k[[S]][[t_1,\ldots,t_n]]$, where $k=A/\mathfrak m$ is a coefficient field; (b) $V[[S]][[t_1,\ldots,t_n]]/(\theta)$, where $V$ is a Cohen ring with residue field $k$ [def-weil-pbc-cohen-ring] and $\theta\equiv p\pmod{(S\setminus\{0\},t_1,\ldots,t_n)}$, with $p$ the uniformizer of $V$. Here formal monoid rings are completions of $E[S][t]$ at $(\mathfrak m_E,S\setminus\{0\},t)$, and monoid rings have basis $[u]$ and multiplication $[u][v]=[u+v]$.
Put $C=A\otimes_{\mathbf Z[R]}\mathbf Z[Q]$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Let $\mathfrak q$ be any prime of $C$ contracting to $\mathfrak m$, put $B=C_{\mathfrak q}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], $F=\{q\in Q:[q]\in B^\times\}$, $T=Q_F/F^{\rm gp}$ with $Q_F=\{q-f:q\in Q,f\in F\}$, and $J=([q]:q\in Q\setminus F)B$. Then there is a nonzero complete regular local ring $D$ [def-weil-regular-scheme] with residue field $\kappa(\mathfrak q)$ and a continuous isomorphism identifying the indicated ideals as follows:
$$ (\widehat B,J\widehat B)\cong (D[[T]],([v]:v\in T\setminus\{0\}))\quad\text{in case (a)},$$
$$ (\widehat B,J\widehat B)\cong (D[[T]]/(\eta),([v]:v\in T\setminus\{0\}))\quad\text{in case (b)},$$
where $\widehat B$ is the maximal-ideal completion, $D[[T]]$ is the completion of $D[T]$ at $(\mathfrak m_D,T\setminus\{0\})$, and the reduction $\overline\eta\in D=D[[T]]/(T\setminus\{0\})$ belongs to $\mathfrak m_D\setminus\mathfrak m_D^2$.

source.place: VI 1.6, printed p. 70 (the two formal models), and VIII 3.1.1--3.1.5, printed pp. 98--99 (face localization). The algebraic base-change statement is an agent-supplied local-model input, not a quotation of VI 1.8; its intended independent argument is in report.md.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-chart-face-residual-unit-decomposition]. It untwists the character, gives $P=K\oplus T$ and $f=(\delta,\beta)$ with $\beta(s)\ne0$ for $s\ne0$, and presents $B$ as the chosen localization of $A\otimes_{\mathbf Z[S]}\mathbf Z[P]$. Original monomials differ from $[k][v]$ only by units.

source.place: VI 1.6 and VIII 3.1.1--3.1.5; assembly of the explicit re-split interfaces; returned proof Steps 1--4

proof.text: Replace $A$ by $\widehat A$, choosing the prime via reduction modulo $\mathfrak m$. Its contractions are the old prime and $\mathfrak m\widehat A$, since $\widehat A/\mathfrak m\widehat A=A/\mathfrak m$. The tensor is finite type over $A$ since $P$ is finitely generated. Apply [lem-trf-finite-type-base-change-adic-quotients]: the compatible local power quotients, hence their limits, agree.

source.place: VI 1.6 and VIII 3.1.1--3.1.5; assembly of the explicit re-split interfaces; returned proof Steps 5

proof.text: Set $L=k$ or $V$ and apply [lem-trf-polynomial-monoid-lift-stratum] to form $R_0,H_S,E,U,W$. In (b) take the inverse-image prime before quotienting by $\theta$. The completed-base presentation gives the chosen localization $W_{\mathfrak n}$ in (a), or $W_{\mathfrak n}/(\theta)$ in (b). The prime contains $(\mathfrak m_L,t)$ from the completed-base maximal ideal; every positive $T$-monomial is a unit multiple of $[q]/[f]$ with $q\notin F$, hence also belongs to it. The cited prime calculation gives $\mathfrak p\supset(\mathfrak m_L,t)$ and residue field $\operatorname{Frac}(E/\mathfrak p)=\kappa(\mathfrak q)$.

source.place: VI 1.6 and VIII 3.1.1--3.1.5; assembly of the explicit re-split interfaces; returned proof Steps 6--7

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-adic-base-tensor-local-comparison] to $(R_0,I,U)$ and $\mathfrak r=\mathfrak pU+(T\setminus\{0\})$. Its hypotheses hold by the polynomial-lift node. Then [lem-trf-laurent-stratum-formal-monoid-completion] gives $\widehat {W_{\mathfrak n}}\cong D[[T]]=:H$, where $D=\widehat {E_{\mathfrak p}}$ is nonzero complete regular local with residue field $\kappa(\mathfrak q)$. The maps preserve coefficients and monomials.

source.place: VI 1.6 and VIII 3.1.1--3.1.5; assembly of the explicit re-split interfaces; returned proof Steps 8--10

proof.text: In (a) this is $\widehat B\cong H$. In (b), $W_{\mathfrak n}$ is Noetherian and $\theta\in\mathfrak n$; [lem-weil-pbc-local-completion-quotient] gives $\widehat B\cong H/(\eta)$. Here $\eta$ is the full continuous substitution of $\theta$, since the comparison fixes $L,t$ and sends $[s]$ to $[\delta(s)][\beta(s)]$. By [lem-trf-cohen-monoid-substitution-parameter], its augmentation lies in $\mathfrak m_D\setminus\mathfrak m_D^2$.

source.place: VI 1.6 and VIII 3.1.1--3.1.5; assembly of the explicit re-split interfaces; returned proof Steps 11--13

proof.text: A nonface $q\in Q$ has nonzero $T$-coordinate, so its monomial maps to a unit times a generator of $(T\setminus\{0\})$. Conversely, lift $v\ne0$ to $q-f\in Q_F$; then $q\notin F$, and the denominator and $K$-monomial are units. This proves both ideal inclusions. All completion comparisons preserve maximal-ideal-power quotients, so are continuous both ways; empty $K,T,t$ lists are allowed.
